tagline: Split a PDF into separate files by clicking between the pages
pageDescription: Split a PDF into separate files with this free online Split PDF tool. Upload your document to see every page as a thumbnail, then click the scissors between pages to set exactly where to cut — no confusing range syntax needed. Extract single pages, split into individual files, or define custom ranges in advanced mode. Everything runs locally in your browser, so your PDF is never uploaded and confidential documents stay private. No signup, no watermarks.

instructions.title: How to split a PDF

steps.title: Upload your PDF
steps.description: Drag and drop a PDF onto the upload area or click to browse. Every page is shown as a thumbnail.

steps.title: Set where to split
steps.description: Click the scissors after any page to add a split point. Use 'Split every page' to separate all pages at once.

steps.title: Check the output
steps.description: The 'Output files' summary shows how many files you'll get and which pages each one contains.

steps.title: Split the PDF
steps.description: Click Split PDF. Each part is created instantly in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

steps.title: Download your files
steps.description: Download each part individually, or grab them all at once as a ZIP archive.
